intervals.label: NEOS phase I data taking
intervals.locator: Applied Antineutrino Physics 2018 proceedings, "Status of NEOS experiment"
intervals.note: Season precision for the start ("summer 2015"); the end follows the next interval (May 2016 removal). The PRL gives an eight-month data-taking period and 180 reactor-on and 46 reactor-off days.
intervals.quote: NEOS phase I data taken from summer 2015 to spring 2016 at Hanbit power plant in ROK

intervals.label: detector removed during reactor inspection
intervals.locator: AAP 2018 proceedings, "Status of NEOS Phase II"
intervals.note: Between NEOS-I and NEOS-II the detector was out of the gallery; the end is the resumption of data taking in September 2018.
intervals.quote: In May 2016, NEOS detector was paused and removed from tendon gallery due to reactor regular inspection.

intervals.label: NEOS-II data taking (one full fuel cycle)
intervals.locator: IAEA Technical Meeting talk, January 2023, slide "NEOS-II"
intervals.note: Month precision; the AAP 2018 proceedings independently say the NEOS-II run resumed in September 2018.

intervals.label: completed
intervals.locator: IAEA Technical Meeting talk, January 2023, slide "NEOS-II"
intervals.note: End of the NEOS-II period as quoted; the talk (January 2023) describes the analysis as still being finalised.

placements.note: Site point is the Hanbit plant centre (campus-grade, ~700 m); see the site record.
placements.quote: The NEOS detector was installed in the tendon gallery of reactor unit 5 of the Hanbit Nuclear Power Complex in Yeonggwang, Korea.

pmt_count.quote: The waveforms of all 38 PMTs are digitized and recorded

summary.plain: A tank holding about a tonne of gadolinium-doped liquid scintillator with photomultiplier tubes, installed in a gallery next to a Korean power-reactor containment building.
summary.technical: About one tonne of Gd-loaded liquid scintillator read out by PMTs (trigger on >= 30 PMT signals above 6 mV), with pulse-shape discrimination and muon veto, in the tendon gallery of Hanbit unit 5.

technology.quote: a detector consisting of a ton of Gd-loaded liquid scintillator in a tendon gallery approximately 24 m from the reactor core
technology.value: Gd-loaded liquid scintillator with PMT readout and pulse-shape discrimination
